metrics.judge_rubric_explanation: Natural spoken phrasing with courteous receptionist tone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good day! Thank you for calling Grand Canal Dental Clinic. My name is DentaCall Receptionist. How can I help you today?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello, I need to reschedule my cleaning appointment and I would like to see Dr. Liam Kelly if possible.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can help you reschedule. I have reserved Thursday at 11:00 AM with Dr. Sarah O'Connor. Please confirm if you would like me to reschedule.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That day is currently fully booked. I have openings available on Thursday morning at 10:00 AM with Dr. Sarah O'Connor. Would that suit you?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Next Wednesday afternoon with Dr. Kelly works.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, your appointment is confirmed and booked in our clinic calendar. Have a wonderful day, goodbye!

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, Wednesday at 2:00 PM with Dr. Kelly is confirmed. Thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You are very welcome! Take care and have a wonderful day, goodbye!
